name: eca
description: ECA (Enterprise Coding Agents) — a six-role coding agent group with a gate-based orchestration protocol. Compatible with ZCode AND Claude Code: ships both .zcode-plugin and .claude-plugin manifests, installs from any Git-hosted marketplace.

plugins.name: eca
plugins.description: Enterprise Coding Agents: six specialized subagents (architect/implementer/reviewer/security/test/debugger) plus an orchestration protocol with typed DoD checklists, three-level delivery acceptance, and mechanical verification gates. Works in ZCode and Claude Code.
